messages.text: An issue with a NerdOctane Don B.
Handed to the team · asked to be reconnected to Georges about an existing NerdOctaxe issue

Georges has it, with a note that you were already talking. He's offline now, so he picks this up Monday at 10am ET and the reply comes to your email, no need to wait here.

Two things so he can start where you left off: what's the email on the order, and what's going wrong with the NerdOctaxe? If it's something simple I may be able to sort it tonight.
(email hidden) its a complex issue that Georges and I have been working on the past half hour. Please connect me.

I can't put you back into that thread, and Georges is offline for the weekend, so I can't get him in here tonight. What I've done is put your case in front of him with your email, (email hidden), so he opens it Monday at 10am ET and replies there. Nothing needs repeating.

If you tell me what the issue is, I'll take a run at it now. Some of it I can fix tonight rather than leave you waiting until Monday.
fan runs fast and slow, cannot connect to wifi.

The fan speeding up and slowing down is normal, it ramps with chip temperature. The wifi is the real issue, and the usual cause is the network: these only join 2.4GHz, not 5GHz. If your router broadcasts both on one name, split them or connect to the 2.4GHz band, then re-run the AP setup from the miner's own hotspot.

Faster help tonight than Monday: our Discord, https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf. Post there and mention JD, @nullhashrate.

Was it ever online on your wifi, or never connected?
no never connected. I have over 80 rigs so very familiar with set up. Display goes on and off also.

Display cutting in and out with the fan surging points at power, not wifi. The board is browning out and rebooting before it ever joins. Swap in a different PSU and cable, something with real headroom, and try a different outlet. If the display then holds steady, that was it.

If it still cycles, that's a hardware fault and it goes to RMA: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12t6skK21Qb8GfAdUQ9nOhJ1tVINJ60T3AIAsyhBwnYM/viewform

Was the unit ever overclocked, and what PSU are you running on it?
Never overclocked because it was never setup. I am using the PSU that came with the unit.

Then it reads as a faulty PSU or a bad board, and with 80 rigs you've already ruled out the usual setup causes. Worth one test if you have a spare brick with the right rating: if it boots clean on that, we just send you a PSU, no need to return the miner.

Either way, file the RMA now so it's in the queue: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12t6skK21Qb8GfAdUQ9nOhJ1tVINJ60T3AIAsyhBwnYM/viewform

I've put this in front of JD, who handles the hardware, and Georges has your thread too.
Handed to the team · DOA NerdOctaxe, power/board fault suspected, needs JD plus PSU-only replacement

JD and Georges both have it with your details. They're offline until Monday 10am ET and will reply to (email hidden), so you don't need to sit here.

If you want an answer sooner, the Discord is live all weekend: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf, tag JD as @nullhashrate. He'll likely spot it from a short video of the display cycling.
please understand I filed a RMA 3 weeks ago with photos and video. I never got any response back (3weeks!) I'm very frustrated......
Used the store-orders skill
Ran find_orders.py (store-orders skill)
Looked something up in Shopify

That's three weeks with no answer, and I'm sorry. That shouldn't have happened, and I'm not going to ask you to file it again.

I've pushed it straight to the team with your email so they can pull the RMA you already submitted, with the photos and video. They're offline until Monday 10am ET and will come back to you at (email hidden)

One thing that helps them find it fast: what's the order number on the NerdOctaxe?
